target.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where Matrix polls would accept more than 20 options despite the Matrix MSC3381 protocol capping poll options at 20. Unlike other channels (Discord=10, WhatsApp=12, MS Teams=12, Telegram=12), the Matrix channel did not enforce its protocol limit, potentially causing protocol violations when sending polls with more than 20 options.

## Why This Change Was Made

Enforce the MSC3381 20-option limit at the Matrix boundary by truncating oversized poll inputs in `buildPollStartContent`. The implementation:
- Truncates options > 20 to the first 20 options (keeps the channel operational for oversized inputs)
- Preserves the shared `normalizePollInput` helper's public contract (omitted `maxOptions` = no limit)
- Avoids adapter-level validation that would interfere with Matrix builder truncation

The truncation approach was chosen per reviewer feedback to ensure existing callers with > 20 options still produce valid `m.poll.start` events instead of failing closed.

## User Impact

Matrix poll senders can now:
- Send polls with up to 20 options (accepted as-is)
- Send polls with > 20 options (truncated to first 20, channel remains operational)
- Other channels and shared poll utilities remain unchanged

No user-visible breaking changes; oversized polls now produce valid Matrix events instead of potentially violating protocol.

## Evidence

### Terminal proof (2026-07-18)

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/matrix/src/matrix/poll-types.test.ts
```

**Output:**
```
 RUN  v4.1.10 /Users/maomaoplanet/projects/xydigit-zt-openclaw-worktrees/pr-104920

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  10 passed (10)
   Start at  23:11:43
   Duration  541ms (transform 426ms, setup 350ms, import 29ms, tests 79ms, environment 0ms)

[test] passed 1 Vitest shard in 3.34s
```

### Real production module execution

```text
[PROOF] Input: 21 options
[PROOF] Output: 20 answers in m.poll.start event
[PROOF] First answer: Option 1
[PROOF] Last answer: Option 20
[PROOF] ✓ Truncated to 20 options (MSC3381 limit)

[PROOF] Input: 20 options
[PROOF] Output: 20 answers in m.poll.start event
[PROOF] ✓ All 20 options preserved

[PROOF] Input: 50 options (no maxOptions specified)
[PROOF] Output: 50 options
[PROOF] ✓ Contract preserved: omitted maxOptions = no limit

[PROOF] Input: 21 options, maxOptions=20
[PROOF] ✓ Throws when maxOptions specified and exceeded (caller-controlled)
```

**Observed behavior:**
- 20 options: accepted and preserved; Matrix builder emits 20 `m.poll.start` answers
- 21 options: Matrix builder **truncates** to first 20 and emits valid `m.poll.start` event
- Shared helper contract: omitted `maxOptions` does not limit options (50 accepted)
- Caller-controlled: explicit `maxOptions` throws when exceeded

This confirms the MSC3381 limit is enforced at the Matrix boundary before event creation, while preserving the shared helper's public contract.

### Test files modified

- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/poll-types.ts` — truncation logic in `buildPollStartContent`
- `extensions/matrix/src/matrix/poll-types.test.ts` — 20-option acceptance and truncation tests
- `src/polls.test.ts` — regression test for omitted `maxOptions` = no limit contract

### Exact commands run

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/polls.test.ts
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/matrix/src/matrix/poll-types.test.ts
```

**Test results:**
```
# src/polls.test.ts — 7 passed
- "does not limit options when maxOptions is omitted" → 50 options accepted ✓

# extensions/matrix/src/matrix/poll-types.test.ts — 10 passed
- "accepts exactly 20 poll options per MSC3381" → answers.length = 20 ✓
- "truncates to 20 poll options per MSC3381 instead of rejecting" → answers.length = 20, first=Option 1, last=Option 20 ✓
```

**Result:** Matrix 20-option protocol limit enforced at Matrix boundary via truncation. Public helper contract preserved. No adapter-level validation interference.
